# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Dynamic 1970 apartheid policies and reciprocal diplomacy.
# Generated by tools/apartheid_1970/compile.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_initialize = yes } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = ZIM } ZIM = { COLDWAR_AP_initialize = yes } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = NAM } NAM = { COLDWAR_AP_initialize = yes } }
			if = { limit = { SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = MLW } MLW = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_historical_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = BOT } BOT = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = LES } LES = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = SWA } SWA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_relations_SAF = yes }
			}
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_AP_contacts_seeded
		}
	}
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_AP_seed = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_initialized } } COLDWAR_AP_initialize = yes }
			if = { limit = { tag = SAF COLDWAR_AP_host = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_AP_contacts_seeded } }
			if = { limit = { SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = MLW } MLW = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_historical_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = BOT } BOT = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = LES } LES = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 if = { limit = { country_exists = SWA } SWA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
			 SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_relations_SAF = yes }
			}
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_AP_contacts_seeded
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes }
			 if = { limit = { tag = SAF } COLDWAR_AP_relations_SAF = yes }
			 if = { limit = { tag = ZIM } COLDWAR_AP_relations_ZIM = yes }
			 if = { limit = { tag = NAM } COLDWAR_AP_relations_NAM = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
